description: The configuration of the settling multi-run measurement: engine main, width 25, all ten LoCoMo conversations, repeated runs. reproduce.py --config config/locomo-next.json runs one of them.

engine.note: Engine main a2943842 (never-drop dates and attribute quarantine, the supersede downgrade, the subject-and-occasion reader check with the verify contract, per-arm width; schema 0028) plus one harness fix, PR #31: a usage cap during ingest stops the run instead of recording an empty conversation. The runs measure this commit.

dataset.name: LoCoMo (locomo10.json)
dataset.question_id_scheme: {sample_id}:q{j}, j the 0-based index into that conversation's qa list

run.runs_note: Independent runs of the whole pipeline, ingest included, over the held-out split. The headline is the mean across completed runs with its spread and each run's own figure beside it. A third run is added if the usage budget allows.
run.k_note: k=25 is the engine's result cap. It is an owner decision recorded on 2026-09-19, not the output of the pre-registered rule, which selected 20: evidence recall on the fullrun-conv-20260916 store was 68.3% at 20 and 69.2% at 25.

models.route_note: At this engine commit the harness reaches the models through the Claude Code CLI. An OpenAI-compatible route for the same model ids is in review as engraphy PR #8; once it lands, the engine pin moves to a commit carrying it and reproduce.py gains --route openai.

thresholds_resolved.note: Read back at runtime from the pinned engine on the onnx-fp32 profile. Recorded here so a change in any of them is a visible diff to this file.

strict.note: The primary figure: the reader may decline, the judge requires every gold item, best of 3.

reference.note: A second figure beside the strict one, for comparability: the reference answer prompt and judge, categories 1 to 4, one judge pass.

arms_note: The primary figure is the shipped default: hybrid search at width 25, no entity roster. The entity roster is measured as a default-off arm by rebuilding envelopes from the same store and re-reading them, so it cannot move the primary figure. The source-turn layer is excluded: it was measured on 2026-09-25 to cost 8 adversarial declines, and storing turns is a design non-goal.

split.note: The seen conversations carried every lever's tuning and subset validation: the retrieval width sweep, the reader replays and the entity-roster analysis. The reported headline is measured on the held-out conversations only, which no lever was fitted to. Figures on the seen split stay published as what they are.
